# People.Studio

> Independent HR advisory and career coaching for UAE and GCC businesses and professionals. Led by Bishoy Mesiha, a senior HR practitioner with 16 years of executive HR experience across MENAT.

People.Studio is a senior-led HR practice — not a firm. It serves founders, GMs, and owner-operators of SMEs (1–150 staff) across the UAE and GCC with practical HR advisory, and works directly with professionals on CV, LinkedIn, and career coaching.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of HR Advisory and Career Studio.
- [HR Advisory](/business): Services for founders, GMs, and owner-operators — Emiratisation, HR setup, org design, retainers.
- [Career Studio](/career): CV writing, LinkedIn optimisation, career coaching, and the free ATS analyser.
- [Free HR Tools](/tools): JD builder, HR policy generator, Emiratisation calculator, HR diagnostic.
- [Legal](/legal): Terms, privacy, and policies.
